title: Torta de Arroz (Rice Cake)
description: A cake made with rice, cream, and lemon.

ingredients.name: one or two spoonfuls orange blossom water
ingredients.sourceText: one or two spoonfuls orange blossom water

steps: Put half pound of rice to cook and gradually add quarter liter of cream and a piece of butter, the outer peel of lemon and salt
When the rice is open and very thick, remove the lemon and let cool in another vessel
Add six beaten egg yolks with sugar and four beaten egg whites with one or two spoonfuls of orange blossom water
Grease a pan or mold of the desired shape with butter, dusting with bread crumbs
Pour in the rice and place on a stove with high heat on its cover
When the cake has taken sufficient color, turn it over onto a plate
In the same manner are made cakes of noodles, semolina, etc.

title: Torta de Arroz (Rice Cake)
description: A cake made with rice, tomatoes, and raisins.
steps: Cook one cup of whole rice in water with a piece of sugar; once cooked, set aside to cool and make a picadillo fried in butter with tomatoes, raisins, almonds, capers, candied citron and a little vinegar.
Beat four eggs, first the whites, and once they are very well beaten mix in the yolks and beat them; once done, mix in the rice leaving aside a little of the beaten egg.
Grease a pan very well with butter and put half the rice at the bottom, the picadillo in the middle and the rest of the rice on top of the meat.
Pour over it the bit of egg that was set aside and place in a small stove that has all the fire removed and only the embers left.

Do not fill the pan to the top but leave the cake about a finger below the rim, or half a finger so it puffs up; on top place a griddle with strong heat and take care that it is well distributed across the entire griddle so it browns evenly.
To know when it is done, insert a popote (drinking straw); when it comes out clean it is ready. When removed, sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

title: Torta de Arroz con Carnes de Puerco y Chorizos (Rice Cake with Pork Meat and Sausages)
description: A cake made with pork, sausages, and cooked rice.

ingredients.name: half pound pork loin cooked with sweets and chopped as for pastel
ingredients.sourceText: half pound pork loin cooked with sweets and chopped as for pastel

steps: Mix half pound of cooked rice with another half of pork loin, cooked with sweets and chopped as for pastel, with ten beaten eggs, first the whites and then the yolks, with sugar, clove, cinnamon and saffron, all ground, and finally with cooked ham and sausages
Put in a casserole greased with butter and let it cook over two fires, adding afterwards on top a little beaten egg white
Serve dry

title: Torta de Arroz con Gallina (Rice Cake with Chicken)
description: A cake made with rice, chicken, and garlic.
steps: After {{source-0}} has been cooked and dried, place it to cool in a casserole
Dust with sugar so it is not too sweet

Cook the chicken, which should also be cooked and dried, with minced garlic, onions, tomatoes and parsley, little pepper and ground cumin, and a bit of sugar, moistening slightly with vinegar and adding salt, small chiles and olives
Let the seasoning rest, and when cold, in a pan prepared with butter and six well-beaten eggs, add the rice and mix with them
Make a layer of this and another of the chicken stew, covering with another layer of rice and any remaining egg
Let the cake set over two fires

title: Torta de Arroz con Jamoncillo de Pepita, Pasas, Almendras, Piñones y Acitron (Rice Cake with Jamoncillo, Raisins, Almonds, Pine Nuts and Citron)
description: A cake made with rice, almonds, and raisins.

ingredients.name: one heaping cup of sifted rice
ingredients.sourceText: one heaping cup of sifted rice

ingredients.name: raisins, almonds and pine nuts for garnish
ingredients.sourceText: raisins, almonds and pine nuts for garnish

steps: Beat twelve eggs, first the whites and then the yolks, and mix in a heaping cup of sifted rice, some well crumbled jamoncillos, almonds, raisins, citron and pine nuts
All together fry in a cake pan with plenty of butter, and when the cake is cooked, add syrup of medium point, made with three pounds of very white sugar, and let it boil until the cake is thick
Decorate for serving with raisins, almonds and pine nuts on top

title: Torta de Arroz con Leche (Rice Cake with Milk)
description: A cake made with rice, milk, and butter.

ingredients.name: clean rice, washed in cold water
ingredients.sourceText: one pound clean rice, washed in cold water

ingredients.name: nearly half an ounce of cinnamon
ingredients.sourceText: nearly half an ounce of cinnamon

ingredients.name: two quartillos of milk with necessary sugar
ingredients.sourceText: two quartillos of milk with necessary sugar

steps: Put in a casserole with boiling water, a finger of butter and a little salt, one pound of clean rice washed in cold water
When it is close to cooking, add nearly half an ounce of cinnamon and two quartillos of milk with the necessary sugar
As soon as it consumes, strain two more quartillos of milk and add them

When the pasta is at the right point, which is known in that it does not fall when turning the casserole over, remove from the fire and empty in a platter to cool, taking care to stir it so that it does not form a skin, and afterwards add six beaten eggs when they are well risen
Put the cake in a pan or cake dish so that it sets over two fires, and serve with syrup made of sugar with cinnamon on top

title: Torta de Arroz con Leche y Natillas (Rice Cake with Milk and Custard)
description: A cake made with rice, milk, and custard.
steps: Cook the rice with milk as in the previous recipe until it has thickened well
Mix with a dozen eggs beaten as for frying, add plenty of ground sugar so the sweetness stands out, and add a quart of thick custard, mixing everything well
Grease a mold with lard, dust with hard, ground biscuit so it takes on all the sides of the pot
Add the rice with the egg and put over two gentle heats

After a while, add on top a thin layer of a couple of eggs beaten with plenty of grated biscuit and put the comal back on it so it forms a crust, ensuring both the heat above and below are gentle to avoid burning
When the cake has set well, adorn with pine nuts, raisins, and toasted almonds and dust with sugar

title: Torta de Arroz con Leche y Picadillo (Rice Cake with Milk and Ground Meat)
description: A cake made with rice, milk, and pork.

ingredients.name: cleaned and soaked rice
ingredients.sourceText: one pound cleaned and soaked rice

ingredients.name: one and a half pounds of ground pork loin
ingredients.sourceText: one and a half pounds of ground pork loin

steps: Grind one pound of clean soaked rice and cook it with six handfuls of strained milk with necessary sugar until it reaches the consistency of white pudding

Cook one and a half pounds of pork loin and then pound it again, then fry it in lard in which garlic cloves have been fried, with a little water, ground cinnamon and clove, whole clove covered, pine nuts, pitted raisins, almonds and ground biscuit as needed to form a paste

Oil a baking pan, dust with ground biscuit, put a layer of the milk and rice mentioned at the beginning, dust with ground biscuit, put another layer of ground meat, dust the same way, and continue in this order until there are three layers of ground meat and four of milk, with the milk as the last layer, which will be covered with biscuit
Put the cake to cook over gentle fires or in the oven
Once it has set, sprinkle ground sugar and cinnamon on top

title: Torta de Arroz y Coco (Rice and Coconut Cake)
description: A cake made with rice, coconut, and raisins.
steps: Clarify two pounds of sugar, and when the syrup reaches the proper point, remove from heat and boil half a pound of well-washed rice
Remove the water and change it until it no longer has starch
Strain through a sieve and place in three portions of milk with sufficient sugar, cooking until very thick, and set aside for the next day
On the following day, beat twelve eggs as for frying and mix in the rice with cinnamon and very little clove
Butter a pot or pan, place in a row a layer with half the rice and egg and on top another of coconut
Add raisins, almonds, pine nuts, walnuts, pieces of candied fruit, and then place the other half of the rice
Bake when bread comes out of the oven, and after the cake is cooked, drown it in syrup, decorating as the others

title: Torta de Artos (Artos Cake)
description: A cake made with starch, egg whites, and egg yolks.
steps: After cleaning, grind one pound of artos until it resembles flour and pass through a sieve
Grind half pound of sugar and sift it
Take what fits in a silver spoon of starch and after grinding mix it with the flour and sugar, place in a large pan
Beat five egg whites as for nougat and when very stiff add five egg yolks
To the flour mixture add five whole eggs, one spoonful butter, salt and half pound butter
Add the beaten eggs and mix with a hand or spoon
Prepare a pan greased with butter
Dust bottom generously with catarino biscuit powder and dust the sides
Pour batter in and dust with more biscuit powder
Cook in a small oven, then remove and leave in hot ashes with a covered pot with fire on top
Test with a straw; if it comes out clean, it is done
Remove from the mold so the biscuit does not stick
Note: if eggs are small, beat six instead of five

title: Torta de Bizcocho y Mantequilla (Sponge Cake and Butter Cake)
description: A cake made with butter, cake, and syrup.
steps: Melt the butter and remove from heat
Mix in as much toasted and ground sponge cake as needed to form a paste that is thick enough to hold together but not so compact that it cannot be eaten
Mix in eggs, beating the egg whites separately from the yolks and then combining both in the proportion of twelve eggs per pound of paste
Once everything is well incorporated, pour into a casserole dish lined with butter placed over gentle heat
Immediately cover with a comal or tin sheet, well fitted, so the cake does not ventilate, with hot coals on top, being careful that it does not burn but only browns
It is ready when it begins to smell; to be sure, use the straw test by inserting a straw into the cake—if it comes out coated, it has not set well; if it comes out dry, the cake is ready
Remove from heat and drain off excess fat
Pierce it with cinnamon sticks all the way to the bottom and with clove

Have ready clarified syrup at low point in the necessary quantity according to the size of the cake; generally make it with two and a half pounds of sugar, which is sufficient for regular-sized common cakes
Place the cake in this syrup, which is returned to heat to boil a while with the cake so it absorbs the sweetness
Remove and let rest until the next day, when it is returned to heat, letting the syrup reduce and basting the cake with it
When the syrup reaches a very high point, almost drying, remove from heat, take off the cinnamon sticks and cloves from the cake, place a plate on top, and flip it over

title: Torta de Calabaza con Leche (Squash Cake with Milk)
description: A cake made with squash, milk, and cake.
steps: Cook a squash prepared like the previous recipe with sugar, cinnamon, and milk
Let it boil on a gentle fire until it breaks down and incorporates with the milk
Continue stirring constantly
Once cooked, strain through fine cloth
Separately cook two quartillos of milk with sugar, cinnamon sticks, orange blossom, and a handful of well-ground almonds
Remove from heat, strain
In a pan greased with butter, place a thin layer of squash
Sprinkle with milk and beaten egg
Then place another layer of thin mamón slices
Moisten them also with milk and cover with a thin layer of butter
Alternate the layers until finishing with a layer of squash
Cook over two fires
Serve hot with almonds and cinnamon on top

title: Torta de Calabaza con Natillas (Pumpkin Cake with Custard)
description: A cake made with pumpkin, cream, and biscuits.
steps: Cook the pumpkin with tequesquite and grind half of it with a plate of cream from cooked milk
Grind separately ten or twelve hard biscuits and some sugar, and mix everything with five beaten eggs
Line a casserole with butter, add considerable bread crumbs and beat five other eggs, pouring half of them into the casserole
Place the pumpkin mixed with the other eggs and biscuits on top, pouring over all of this the remaining beaten egg
Put the casserole in the oven at a moderate temperature
After the cake is cooked, serve dusted with sugar

title: Torta de Calabaza de Castilla (Castilian Squash Cake)
description: A cake made with squash, cake, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: One medium ripe Castilian squash, peeled and cleaned
ingredients.sourceText: One medium ripe Castilian squash, peeled and cleaned

steps: Cut the squash into pieces and cook in very little water with sugar to taste, cloves, and cinnamon sticks
Stir frequently until it breaks down
Once cooked, strain through fine cloth and beat with six egg yolks
Grease a cake pan with butter
Spread a thin layer of squash on the bottom
Sprinkle with white wine, dust with cinnamon powder, and cover with beaten egg
Place another layer of thin mamón slices
Sprinkle with wine and half-point syrup, add cinnamon powder and a thin layer of butter
Alternate layers until finishing with a layer of squash
Cover the pan with a griddle and cook the cake over two moderate fires
Serve hot dusted with cinnamon powder, almonds, and toasted sesame seeds on top

title: Torta de Calabaza de Castilla con Queso y Ajonjolí (Castilian Squash Cake with Cheese and Sesame)
description: A cake made with squash, sesame, and grated cheese.

ingredients.name: Toasted and ground biscuit as needed
ingredients.sourceText: Toasted and ground biscuit as needed

steps: Cook, peel, and clean the squash
Grind it and when well drained, measure two calderas cups of it
Mix with a little toasted sesame, clove, cinnamon, and powdered pepper
Add grated cheese and sifted sugar in quantities sufficient to taste
Add toasted and ground biscuit as necessary for the paste to be very thick
Beat the egg whites and yolks separately until well risen
Incorporate everything together
Pour into a greased pan or pot
Let it set over two fires, taking care it does not burn

description: A cake made with cake, egg yolks, and egg white.

ingredients.name: Milk, boiled until very concentrated and sweet

ingredients.name: Three egg yolks for each cup of milk

steps: Boil the milk until very concentrated and well sweetened, then measure it in cups
For each cup, lightly beat three egg yolks, which are stirred with the milk
In a pan coated with butter, place marquesote in layers, wetting each layer with the prepared milk and filling the pan in this way
After the last layer is well moistened, put the pan of milk on the fire so it curdles more and remains with skin, like jericalla, and pour it over the marquesote in the pan
Cook at two fires or in the oven
Test with a knife or a straw if the cake is cooked, and once done, leave for another day
On the next day, clarify syrup made at medium point, strain through a serviette and put back on the fire
Divide the cake into slices of the size desired, pierce with a straw and put in the honey to boil on low heat
Once the syrup is at point, remove from heat, put the cake on plates and decorate with raisins, almonds, pine nuts, and powdered cinnamon on top

ingredients.sourceText: More than half a large cold biscuit

Coat a pot well with butter that is not new
Crumble more than half of a large cold biscuit into the pot
Pour the milk into the pot, crumble more biscuit, and add pieces of butter until completing one pound, accounting for what was used to coat the pot

Strain through a sieve and sweeten a little more than usual
Pour into the pot and put the cake in the oven to brown, or cook it over coals, and after it has set, cover it with a comal with fire on top

title: Torta de Maíz (Corn Cake)
description: A cake made with corn, almonds, and sugar.
steps: Buy cacahuazentle corn, grind and sift it
Grind sugar and weigh three eggs
Weigh the same amount of corn, the same of sugar, the same of butter as the eggs weigh, and four ounces of almonds
Grind the almonds with a little milk
Beat together the sugar, corn, and butter
Separately, beat the yolks as for royal eggs and the whites as for nougat
Mix everything together and beat until foamy
Butter the mold and pour everything into it
Send to the oven to bake. Must beat a lot.

title: Torta de Pies de Puerco (Pork Feet Cake)
description: A cake made with pork, hen, and garlic.

ingredients.name: molleja or liver, or small fish pieces
ingredients.sourceText: molleja or liver, or small fish pieces

steps: When the pork feet are half-cooked, add a hen so that everything finishes cooking together.
Skim the broth and add salt, all spices, ground garlic, and chorizos.
Do this the day before the cake is to be eaten.
On the day it is to be served, make a picadillo with all its requisites, adding four to six beaten eggs stirred so they are set, and a little saffron.
To the broth in which the hen cooked, well seasoned with all spices, add a little vinegar.
Beat ten to twelve eggs separately, beating first the whites and then adding the yolks.
Put the picadillo in a pan over the fire, gradually adding sliced tongue, pieces of pork feet without bones, hen, chorizo, sliced hard-boiled eggs, raisins, almonds, olives, and capers.
Pour this over half the beaten egg in a pan with very hot lard so it sets, doing so carefully so the pieces of picadillo do not mix with the egg.
After adding the picadillo, cover it completely with the other half of the beaten egg.
When recognized with a knife that the cake is set, lower it to the ground by placing a comal on top so it cooks without lard.
When well browned, if the pan is not full, add more well-puffed beaten eggs and put the comal on top again.
If there is suspicion that the cake is not well cooked, put it back on gentle fire until it is.

For the sauce, fry from morning twelve ground tomatoes with garlic, chiles, and parsley, then adding a little broth, eight egg yolks, and the juice of two lemons, stirring quickly so the yolks break down.
Let it simmer for a while and add all spices and more well-washed capers, or in their place molleja or small liver pieces, or small fish pieces, mint, parsley, and saffron.
When bringing to the table, add olives and any other garnishes desired.

title: Torta de Piña de los Virreyes (The Viceroys' Pineapple Cake)
description: A cake made with pineapples, syrup, and rice.
steps: Remove the hearts of the pineapples, chop them, and cook them
When done, place in clarified syrup
When they reach the proper stage, remove and drain well
Cook half a pound of soaked rice in a napkin hung inside a pot so it cooks
When well cooked, remove and let drain so no water remains
Beat eggs in proportion, about eight per pineapple
Add the drained pineapple, rice, raisins, almonds, and pine nuts to the eggs
Mix everything very well
Butter a pot and pour everything in and cook over two fires
When cooked, let the cake cool
Make small quarter-sized pieces and place in syrup

steps: Peel pine nuts of good color and after grinding them to a pound weight, mix them with {{source-1}}

Coat a pot with lard and put a sheet of dough at the bottom

title: Torta de Sesos con Leche, Arroz y Yemas de Huevo (Brains Pie with Milk, Rice and Egg Yolks)
description: A pastry dish made with milk, rice, and egg yolks.
steps: Cook the sheep brains in water with salt, and after cooking clean them well

For each brain, cook three quartillos of milk with white sugar, mixed with a handful of whole rice well washed and sun-dried, with two egg yolks dissolved in the same milk, one cinnamon stick and a few cloves
Once the rice is cooked, dissolve the brains in it
Beat twelve eggs for each brain, first the whites and then the yolks, and after stirring, break the mixture formed of the brains, rice and milk into them
Butter a pie dish, pour the said composition into it, and cook at two gentle fires, taking care to add butter from time to time around the edges
Once the pie is set, serve sprinkled with ground cinnamon

ingredients.name: half a pound of solid pork meat, chopped
ingredients.sourceText: half a pound of solid pork meat, chopped

steps: Grind the cleaned and soaked rice
Cook it with the strained milk and necessary sugar until it reaches the consistency of manjar blanco
Cook the solid pork meat and chop it
Chop it again finely
Fry garlic cloves and add the ground meat to lard with a little water, cinnamon, ground cloves, white wine, pine nuts, pitted raisins, almonds, and some ground hard biscuits
Butter a cake pan and dust it with ground biscuit
Lay a layer of milk and dust with more biscuit
Add a layer of the ground meat mixture with biscuit, similar to the previous layer
Continue until you have three layers of milk and three of meat mixture, in the order described, with the final layer being milk
Sprinkle more biscuit on top
Cook between two gentle fires or in an oven
Once set, place powdered sugar and ground cinnamon on top
Serve cold

Add a layer of the ground meat mixture with biscuit, similar to the previous layer

Sprinkle more biscuit on top
Cook between two gentle fires or in an oven

Cook the cake over two fires or in the oven

description: Prepared with fish roe or carp or roe, garlic, and onion.

ingredients.name: two fish roe from carp for six people, or eight from juil if carp roe is not available
ingredients.sourceText: two fish roe from carp for six people, or eight from juil if carp roe is not available

ingredients.name: fresh tuna, or in its absence well-desalted snook
ingredients.sourceText: fresh tuna, or in its absence well-desalted snook

steps: Lightly cook the well-washed roe, placing them in already boiling slightly salted water for five minutes
Take a piece of fresh tuna and minced garlic cloves very finely
Mince the roe and the fish so that it mixes well with the rest
Put everything in a pot with a little butter and let it sauté until well melted
Take another bit of butter to taste and mix it with parsley and onion, place in a fish baking dish sprinkling it with lemon juice, then place immediately on hot ashes
Beat twelve fresh eggs with the sautéed fish and egg mixture; stir until the mixture is perfect, and make the tortilla in the customary manner

Ensure three things: first, it is necessary to sauté the roe and fish when frying them, avoiding boiling so they do not harden; second, the fish baking dish should be deep so that the sauce can be served with a spoon; third and last, heat the fish baking dish that will receive the dish and place it on the table so it can retain its temperature for a long time without the butter setting from cold

Mix with twelve eggs, half a pound of butter, a medium fresh cheese grated that is not very buttery, and {{source-4}}

Put it in small paper boxes spread with butter without filling them, because the tortillas swell when cooking, which is done in a moderate oven

ingredients.name: fresh pork meat covered with fat

steps: Divide the fresh pork meat covered with fat into pieces
Put all these pieces with a small quantity of water in a pan over very hot fire
Let the fat melt and the water evaporate

Take them out, drain them and serve
Purify and save the remaining lard for use

description: Prepared with spinach, almond, and orange.
steps: Clean, wash thoroughly and cook the spinach in a pot with a little water
Drain and let cool, then squeeze and press well
Grind in a mortar or mill on a metate
Add a little fresh butter, grated green lemon zest and two bitter almond biscuits with sugar and orange blossom water, grinding or pounding both together a second time
Make a base of thin puff pastry dough and divide into small pieces
Put about half a walnut of spinach filling in one corner of each piece and moisten and cover the toasts with dough
Round them with a knife and then fry in the lean frying fat
When well browned, drain and arrange neatly on a plate
Dust with sugar, pass a hot iron over them so they caramelize, and serve hot as a light course

description: Prepared with trout, onions, and bay leaves.
steps: Cut thin strips from the trout, slightly longer than a finger and roughly the same thickness
Place in a casserole with salt, coarse pepper, parsley sprigs, four sliced medium onions, two bay leaves, some thyme, and the juice of two lemons

Dust flour over the trout strips, toss well in the same linen, shake off excess, and fry in the hot butter until golden
Arrange in a heap on a plate and serve with spicy sauce

title: Trucha en Caldillo Ligero (Trout in Light Broth)
description: A soup made with trout, onion, and bay leaves.
steps: Clean the trout without opening the belly, wash it, dry it very well, tie the head with thread, and place it in a fish kettle
Add onion slices, four cloves, four bay leaves, some sprigs of thyme, a handful of parsley sprigs, salt, and six bottles of white wine
Allow to cook over low heat for one hour, or longer if the fish is large and fat

The cooked trout can be served in various ways: roasted in a napkin, folded on a plate; surrounded by parsley à la genovese; moistened with red wine; with a little salt in the same broth in which it cooked, which for this is strained through silk; the same as salmon à la genovese (see page 761); and in short, the cooked trout can be served in the various ways in which salmon is served

title: Turco de Harina de Trigo (Wheat Flour Cake)
description: A cake made with wheat flour and water.
steps: Put wheat flour in water, mix well and let it settle
Decant the water or remove it carefully without stirring the settled flour
Put the flour in a cloth napkin, tie it and hang it so that all the water drains out
When it stops dripping, put it to dry well in the sun
Grind it afterwards and sift it in a sifting sieve
Knead with lard, cooked egg yolks and sugar to taste, so that the dough becomes soft and can be ground
Make little tortillas from it on the metate, with which the turco is formed the same as in the previous articles

title: Turco de Leche y Almendra (Corn Drum with Milk and Almond)
description: Prepared with milk, almond, and egg yolks.
steps: Sift the washed nixtamal through a cloth, grind it dry, tint it with a bit of carmine, and mix with three egg yolks and necessary lard
Using this dough, form the box inside a lard-greased pot
Bring four cuartillos of milk to cook, and before it boils add {{source-5}}, stirring well and straining immediately
Add {{source-6}} and, when boiling, {{source-7}}
When it is almost at soft-ball stage, add {{source-8}} and a bit of ground carmine dissolved in orange blossom water until the paste becomes nacreous
Once at soft-ball stage, remove from heat and fill the dough box formed inside the pot with this paste, adding raisins, almonds, pine nuts, and sesame
Cover with layers of dough made thin and brushed with lard, and place another layer on top to form a crust
Decorate with dough ornaments and figurines as desired, and bake in an oven or over two fires
Once the turco is well browned, brush with lard and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon

title: Turrón Blanco de Cuchara con Almendras, Piñones, Nueces y Ajonjolí (White Spoon Nougat with Almonds, Pine Nuts, Walnuts and Sesame)
description: Prepared with walnuts, pine nuts, and honey.

ingredients.name: one and a half pounds of sugar
ingredients.sourceText: one and a half pounds of sugar

ingredients.name: half a pound of peeled and ground almonds
ingredients.sourceText: half a pound of peeled and ground almonds

steps: Make a syrup with one and a half pounds of sugar, clarify it, strain it and bring it to the point of setting in cold water
Remove from heat, add about a small cup of virgin honey, and beat until it becomes grainy

Add nine egg whites that have been beaten until stiff, after removing their oil, and when well incorporated, place the pan over covered coals to boil, continuing to beat gently until the egg is cooked, which is known if when tasted it does not taste raw
Remove from fire and mix in half a pound of peeled and ground almonds, split walnuts, clean pine nuts and toasted sesame seeds
Beat again until it acquires such consistency that when poured onto a plate it does not run, but not so much that it becomes hard
Pour into a platter and decorate with small balls of the same mixture, placing a raisin in the middle, and dusting with dragée

title: Turrón de Alicante (Alicante Nougat)
description: Prepared with honey, egg whites, and almonds.

ingredients.name: one arroba and two cuartillos more of virgin honey
ingredients.sourceText: one arroba and two cuartillos more of virgin honey

steps: After clarifying one arroba of sugar, mix with another arroba and two cuartillos more of virgin honey, choosing the clearest; strain through fine cloth and place on heat to reach the soft ball stage, taking care to remove with a small broom what sticks around the edge of the pan

After it has reached the point, remove and cool with a paddle, adding six well-beaten egg whites, and beating everything with the paddle by force of arms until it turns white, having repeated four times the operation of adding six egg whites
As soon as it is white and thick, remove with a finger a thimbleful of nougat, which when immediately immersed in cold water should break
If the fire is very strong, diminish it somewhat by covering with some bricks or sherds, and add as much almond as it can hold

ingredients.name: very white and fluffy sugar

steps: Put {{source-0}} in a pan with one cuartillo of virgin honey, clarify both together, and after straining this syrup, return it to the heat until it rises in point, which is known by taking a little bit and throwing it in cold water to see if it breaks, and checking if the point is that of toffees, which is what it should have
If it is so, remove from heat and keep stirring until it cools

Have ready beaten and very fluffy egg whites, at the rate of ten for each pound of sugar, and add a few of them; beat them strongly in the syrup, and when these are consumed add more, increasing this way until all are added

Reach the point where it hardens in water
Remove from fire

Pour into small boxes or dishes

title: Turrón Mejor que el de Alicante (Nougat Better than Alicante)
description: Prepared with honey, egg whites, and water or citron or lime or orange or lemon.

ingredients.name: purified or Holland sugar in small lumps

ingredients.name: fragrant water or citrus peel (citron, lime, orange, or lemon)

Mix both together and incorporate 5 beaten egg whites when they reach the flower point
Continue beating and stirring until reaching the caramel point
Add 1/4 pound of peeled almonds in small pieces, well-dried in the stove or over a hot comal but not toasted

Remove from fire promptly to avoid overdoing the caramel point

Extend the paste with a roller to 2 or 3 fingers thick

Store in a dry place or serve immediately

title: Uvate de Vino Crudo o Mosto (Grape Preserves Made with Raw Wine or Must)
description: A fruit preserve made with grapes.
steps: Express the juice from degrained grapes, pour it into a cauldron and let it boil gently, skimming and stirring it frequently so that it does not stick to the bottom and the uvate does not acquire a burnt taste
As the juice cooks and thickens, gradually reduce the fire, and when it is reduced to a third, pass it through a strainer, let it finish cooking, and then pour it into very clean jars
To give this preserve consistency and a particular taste, add the best pears that can be found, cut in quarters and mixed with it

title: Vaca (Blanquete de) a la Burguesa (Beef Blanquette Bourgeois Style)
description: Prepared with beef, lard, and broth.
steps: Cook a square or loin of beef on the roasting spit
When cooked, let cool immediately
Carefully remove the sirloin and cut into small pieces the size of a coin
Place in a saucepan between slices of lard
Let warm for half an hour in a bain-marie in a stove
Clarify and reduce two ladles of white substance with a little consumed broth
Bind with three egg yolks
Add four ounces of fresh butter, the juice of one lemon, and a little minced parsley
Add the beef blanquette to this sauce and serve with fried croutons around it

title: Vaca (Cecina Frita de) (Fried Beef Jerky)
description: Prepared with beef, vinegar, and capers.
steps: Soak the jerky in water to desalt it
Rinse it well and soak again briefly in salted water with vinegar
Remove and dry with a clean cloth
Coat with oil and dust with ground cloves, pepper, and cumin
Decorate on one side with a row of capers, another of strips of cooked lemon, and another of cooked and crumbled chonzón meat
Roll very tightly, tie with thread, and place to cook in water with salt, vinegar, small onions, a piece of celery, and butter
Once cooked, slice the meat, coat the slices in flour, and fry in butter
In the broth left behind, whisk a mixture of three egg yolks, broth, parsley, and chopped shallot, and deglaze what may have stuck to the pot, leaving it to thicken over the fire
Add a splash of vinegar, some whole pepper and salt if the lard is not sufficiently salted or if ham has not been used in its place
Pour this sauce over the meat

title: Vaca (Cuadrado de) Empapelado (Beef Square in Paper Wrapping)
description: Prepared with beef, tongue, and shallots.
steps: Prepare a square of beef as for roasting
Lard it with medium strips of scarlet tongue
Place in a saucepan with a large piece of butter, parsley, shallots, mushrooms, truffles, garlic, thyme, bay leaf, salt, pepper and nutmeg
Let cook for one hour
Remove the square and add to the herbs the remaining butter in the pan, a little brandy and a bottle of white wine
Let this mixture reduce to a jelly
Add to this two spoonfuls of German sauce and a bit of very fresh butter
Pour all this over the beef square and let cool
Garnish well with fine herbs and thin slices of ham
Wrap in sheets of oiled paper held with string
Place on the grill over hot fire
When the paper takes on good color, serve the beef in the paper, removing the string
Can serve separately a thick Spanish sauce

title: Vaca Escabechada (Pickled Beef)
description: Prepared with meat, vinegar, and garlic.

ingredients.name: two heads of garlic roasted in the embers
ingredients.sourceText: two heads of garlic roasted in the embers

steps: Slice the meat and beat it well so that it remains the thickness of two fingers.
Fry the slices in oil, making sure they remain whitish and not toasted.
Put them in a pot with the vinegar, herbs, and the two whole, clean heads of garlic.
If the meat is cooked and the vinegar has not been consumed, distill it so that only the oil remains.
Add salt to taste and leave in the pot two or three days or more until it cools.
When serving, add more oil and Castilian vinegar.
Serve cold and garnish with olives, capers, and chiles.

title: Vaca Guisada a la Burguesa (Beef Stew in Bourgeois Style)
description: Prepared with beef, bay leaf, and peas.
steps: Place a piece of butter in a pot and melt it over the fire
Add two tablespoons of flour and let it fry and brown in the butter
Add the piece of beef to be stewed and keep stirring and turning it with the brown substance until it becomes firm
Add hot water to the stew, stirring until it boils
Season with salt, pepper, one bay leaf, and a little thyme
After boiling for one hour, add as much as desired of the following already cooked items: peas, onions, mushrooms, and carrots
If the stew remains white, bind it with egg yolks

title: Venason de Vaca para Comerse Fría (Cold Roast Beef)

Add more oil, orange leaves, a sliced lemon, some Castilian vinegar, another of red wine and another of hot water, until the liquid covers the meat
Cook over low heat, taking care that it does not fall apart, until the broth is consumed
Remove the cooked pieces of beef and finish reducing the cooking liquid
Add a little oil and red wine to the reduced liquid to fry the cooked pieces there, one by one, turning on both sides
Place on a platter over orange leaves and cover with the sediment from the pot with some strips of cooked ham

title: Vinagre de Estragón (Tarragon Vinegar)
description: Prepared with vinegar, tarragon, and lemons.

ingredients.name: Twelve cuartillos of good white Castilian vinegar
ingredients.sourceText: Twelve cuartillos of good white Castilian vinegar

ingredients.name: One and a half pounds of tarragon leaves, wilted in the shade
ingredients.sourceText: One and a half pounds of tarragon leaves, wilted in the shade

steps: Pour twelve cuartillos of good white Castilian vinegar into a large bottle
Add one and a half pounds of tarragon leaves that have been left to wilt in the shade, taking care to spread them out so they do not scald
When the leaves have become limp, add them to the bottle with the vinegar
Add a small bundle of cloves and the stripped peels of two lemons
Seal the bottle very well
Place it daily in the sun for fifteen days, or put it in the oven two or three times after the bread has been removed
After this time has passed, the vinegar is ready to use and it is unnecessary to add salt as is generally done

Decant the vinegar and press out the sediment or leaves remaining at the bottom of the vessel, filtering the vinegar through brown paper or a piece of cotton or bombazine cloth, or place the vinegar over a large horsehair sieve with a wheel of brown paper made of two sheets spread one over the other covering the entire bottom of the sieve and protruding two or three inches from the edges, and gently pour the vinegar through until it is perfectly clarified
Once this operation is complete, bottle it and seal it very well

steps: For a medium barrel full of cider or pear cider, prepare one and a half pounds of leavening made with rye flour

Once it has soured, dissolve it with warm water and introduce it through the hole of the barrel

Place the barrel in a warm place or room like a kitchen

title: Vino de Chabacano (Apricot Wine)
description: Prepared with wine, apricots, and powdered sugar.
steps: Remove the fuzz from the apricots, cut them into pieces, remove the pits, and press the pulp to extract all the juice
Place the juice in a porcelain vessel or a large barrel if the quantity is large, cover it with cloth and let it rest for fifteen days to three weeks while fermentation occurs

When fermentation has finished, the liquid will have a film on the surface and exhale a strong odor; then separate the crust, decant, strain to remove any particles that may have risen during decantation, and mix with one pound of spirit of wine and two pounds of powdered white sugar for every eight quartillos of juice
Return to another vessel for fifteen days, filter and bottle
After one month it will be ready to serve

title: Vitualla (Mixed Vegetables and Meats)
description: Prepared with cabbage, potatoes, and carrots.

ingredients.name: a handful of very tender peas
ingredients.sourceText: a handful of very tender peas

ingredients.name: a handful of string beans, trimmed and shredded
ingredients.sourceText: a handful of string beans, trimmed and shredded

ingredients.name: butter and oil in equal parts
ingredients.sourceText: butter and oil in equal parts

steps: Boil one good cabbage, three or four large potatoes, one small calabash, two carrots, two lettuces, a pair of parsnips, four or six turnips, the same number of kohlrabies, and two sweet potatoes, a handful of very tender peas, a handful of green beans, and a handful of string beans trimmed and shredded, adding necessary salt
When everything is well cooked, refresh it in clean water
Roughly chop half the potatoes and carrots, the turnips and kohlrabies, the larger leaves of cabbage, and all the lettuces
Combine the chopped vegetables with the string beans, peas and beans, and fry in a casserole that has equal parts butter and oil in which two cleaned cloves of garlic have been browned
Add a little vinegar and powdered pepper
When well dried, remove this vegetable from the fire
Place another casserole on the fire with butter and fry chorizos, longaniza, and sausages whole in it
When these are well fried, remove them from the butter and fry in it long plantains sliced lengthwise

With everything thus prepared, place all the chopped vegetable at the bottom of a platter, and on top all the whole pieces, peeling the sweet potatoes, potatoes and everything that has a skin that does not please the eye
Also place on top of the fried vegetables the chickpeas, ham, chorizos, longaniza and fried sausages, the cured beef and plantain, placing only mutton, veal and chicken on the meat part

title: Zumo de Agraz (Verjuice)
description: Prepared with grapes and salt.

ingredients.name: Spirit of wine (optional, for preservation or beverages)
ingredients.sourceText: Spirit of wine (optional, for preservation or beverages)

steps: Pick the agraz before it begins to ripen
Separate the grapes from the bunches
Remove the stems or stalks from the grapes
Place the grapes in a marble mortar with a little salt
Pound the grapes
Press the juice through a linen cloth by hand force or in a press
Filter the juice one or two times through flannel or cotton cloth, dampened and coated with flour on the napped side of the cloth, hung open
Pour the verjuice repeatedly through the filters so that when filtered it becomes as clean and clear as distilled or stone-filtered water
Prepare bottles by scrubbing them well or use new ones, which is better, so they do not smell bad or impart bad taste to the verjuice
Sulfur the bottles in this manner: choose a cork that fits all of them, pierce it with an iron wire, fasten it at the top of the cork and make a clasp or hook at the other end
Ensure the wire does not pass through the middle of the bottle
Attach a sulfur stick to the clasp or hook, light it and insert it into the bottles one by one
When the bottles have filled with vapor or smoke, remove the sulfur stick and stand them in the wine cellar or bottle rack
After a moment, pour the verjuice into the bottles and cork them well
When using the verjuice, remove the film or membrane that will have formed at the neck of the bottles
The verjuice can be employed in place of lemon in all compositions where the latter is used, and also for fresh beverages and punches, adding a little spirit of wine to it
It is good for preventing the inconveniences of falls, taking for this a glass when the accident has just occurred

title: Almondegas de Carne de Vacca (Beef Meatballs)
description: Prepared with beef, bacon, and onion.

ingredients.name: four to six spoons wheat flour
ingredients.sourceText: four to six spoons wheat flour

steps: Chop together two pounds of beef with half pound of fresh bacon, one onion, one clove of garlic, salt, parsley and fine pepper.
Add more four to six spoons of wheat flour and three eggs.
Knead everything together.
Form then balls the size of ordinary English potatoes, which are fried in rendered fat, this should be very hot at the moment the balls are put into it.
Serve with any of the sauces indicated for beef.

title: Almondegas de Carne Secca (Dried Meat Meatballs)
description: Prepared with beef, onion, and pork.
steps: Soak the Rio Grande dried meat in hot water for twelve hours.
Remove and dry it well and chop it very finely.
Add to it an equal amount of salt cod.
For two pounds of this mixture, add one bowl of palm fiber, six eggs, one onion, parsley, all finely chopped, little salt and pepper.
Make a dough, and from it form balls, which are fried in pork lard, and served with corn porridge or bean paste.

title: Almondegas de Gallinha (Chicken Meatballs)
description: Prepared with chicken, lard, and bread.
steps: Take the chicken and remove its meat
Chop the meat very finely with a quarter pound of lard, little salt, grated nutmeg, three crushed cardamom seeds, a handful of bread crumb, four egg yolks and one spoonful of sugar
Mix everything well and form small balls
Fry them in a little fat
Serve with fresh vegetables, squash shoots or cooked palm hearts

Form balls which are fried in butter.

title: Almondegas de paca (Paca Meatballs)
description: Prepared with bacon, onion, and mushrooms.

ingredients.name: one paca, cooked in water and salt
ingredients.sourceText: one paca, cooked in water and salt

ingredients.name: a portion of bread crumb softened in milk
ingredients.sourceText: a portion of bread crumb softened in milk

steps: Cook one paca in water and salt, separating the meat from the bones

Chop it with half a pound of bacon, one onion, and a portion of carapicús (mushrooms), a portion of bread crumb softened in milk, four egg yolks, salt, ground pepper, one clove of garlic, and grated nutmeg
Mix everything well and form into balls
Wrap them in wheat flour and pass them through egg yolks to cover them with breadcrumbs
Fry them in plenty of fat
Serve with this same fat, or better with some spicy sauce and salads

title: Anta Assada no Espeto (Tapir Roasted on a Spit)
description: Prepared with pork fat, garlic, and onions.
steps: Lard the tapir loin with pork fat seasoned in salt, pepper, garlic
Put it to marinate in salt, parsley, onions, pepper comazí, and vinegar, enough to moisten, for twelve hours in this seasoning
Thread it on the spit wrapping it in paper greased with butter or fat, and roast over a regular fire
When cooked, remove it and coat it with a beaten egg yolk, and give it a few more turns on the spit so the meat takes on good color; serve with salads

title: Anta Assada no Forno (Tapir Roasted in the Oven)
description: Prepared with meat, vinegar, and brown sugar.

ingredients.name: four to five tablespoons of brown sugar
ingredients.sourceText: four to five tablespoons of brown sugar

steps: Put a cut of tapir meat to marinate in vinegar with four to five tablespoons of brown sugar, {{source-3}}, pepper, onion leaves, cloves and marjoram
After twenty-four hours, remove it and lard it with thick pieces of pork fat and small pieces of garlic
Wrap it in a coating made with {{source-10}}, two whole eggs, {{source-12}}, and enough milk to form a dough, which is spread on a cloth and in which the cut of meat is wrapped
Put the cut of meat thus prepared in a pan, having placed at the bottom of it a slice of pork fat; roast it in the oven or over moderate heat, for which three hours are needed; serve with the coating

title: Anta Ensopada com Cará do Ar (Tapir in Broth with Air Yam)
description: A soup made with meat, fat, and wheat flour.

ingredients.name: one glass of sour orange juice
ingredients.sourceText: one glass of sour orange juice

steps: Take a piece of tapir meat and braise it in fat with {{source-2}}, one chopped onion, salt and two pepper corns and half a dozen tomatoes

Let it boil until the meat is cooked and the broth is reduced

title: Anta Estufada (Braised Tapir)
description: Prepared with bacon, wine, and vinegar.
steps: Place the tapir loin in a pan lined with lardoon slices of bacon, with {{source-2}}, one glass of vinegar, {{source-4}}, two cut onions, one clove of garlic, salt, peppers, and two cloves
Leave the meat in these seasonings for six hours, turning from time to time
Seal the lid, place the pan over the fire, and boil for two to three hours
Serve with the strained sauce without fat

title: Anta Estufada com Caratinga (Braised Tapir with Caratinga)
description: Prepared with bacon, milk, and salt.

ingredients.name: one or two caratinga roots, peeled and cut into slices
ingredients.sourceText: one or two caratinga roots, peeled and cut into slices

steps: Boil a tapir loin for five to ten minutes in milk and salt
Remove it and let it cool
Lard it with bacon seasoned with salt and pepper
Place it in a pan lined with bacon and {{source-7}}, salt, {{source-8}}, one clove of garlic, a little grated ginger, and one or two peeled caratinga roots cut into slices
Cover the pan, seal it, and leave it to boil over an active fire for two to three hours
Serve with its sauce
